sets.relationshipLabel: a literary genre and its canonical work
sets.explanation: Each genre is paired with the work most people would name first as its defining example.

sets.relationshipLabel: a craftsperson and the tool of their trade
sets.explanation: Each artisan is defined by the hand-tool that no one in their trade works without.

sets.relationshipLabel: an object and the physical part it always has
sets.explanation: A book always has a spine and a scroll always has a rod — the structural part is what makes each object function as it does.

sets.relationshipLabel: the start and end of a span
sets.explanation: Checkout/return and opening/closing each mark the two edges of a bounded span, one for a loan and one for an event.
